scope: All entries in current project implementation backlog; not exhaustive Autodesk Revit parity
limitations: No GUI branch build or interaction test
Branch source filenames are not proof of working features

entries.task: Unified typed document model and IDs
entries.acceptance: Single document can edit walls, families and MEP networks
entries.initial_assessment: PARTIAL / BRANCH: main has domain engines and oplog; provisional document code is on GUI/foundation branches. Typed model and oplog convergence still needs review (#24).

entries.task: Command registry / previews / undo
entries.acceptance: Same command callable by UI and API
entries.initial_assessment: PARTIAL: oplog provides transaction primitives. A unified UI/API command registry is still a documented target (#37); branch automation exists but does not prove registry completion.

entries.task: Dependency graph and incremental regeneration
entries.acceptance: Edit affects only dependency closure; benchmark
entries.initial_assessment: OPEN GAP: incremental dependency-closure regeneration is required; #14 reports whole-model rebuilds. The issue is evidence of a reported gap, not a fresh benchmark.

entries.task: Native project persistence, recovery
entries.acceptance: Save/open/crash recovery exact committed state
entries.initial_assessment: PARTIAL / UNVERIFIED: oplog and document primitives do not establish native save/open, schema migration and crash recovery acceptance.

entries.task: IFC import, preservation and round-trip
entries.acceptance: Supported classes round-trip without identity loss
entries.initial_assessment: PARTIAL: main contains a native Rust IFC writer and independent checker scripts. Import/preservation/round-trip completeness is not established by exporter tests.

entries.task: egui desktop shell (decided 15 Oct 2026; prototype on `feature/rust-gui`)
entries.acceptance: Ribbon with icons, Place Duct end-to-end, measured latency
entries.initial_assessment: PROTOTYPE ON BRANCH: origin/feature/rust-gui contains apps/desktop and an expanded workspace; main does not include the desktop app. No GUI build or interaction run performed in this review.

entries.task: Ribbon, context bar and command search
entries.acceptance: PDF Systems ribbon and contextual actions implemented
entries.initial_assessment: PROTOTYPE / UNVERIFIED: GUI branch includes ribbon.rs and icons.rs; contextual command completeness and latency remain to be tested.

entries.task: Project Browser, Properties, dock layouts
entries.acceptance: Type/instance edits; multi-select; persisted layout
entries.initial_assessment: PROTOTYPE / UNVERIFIED: GUI branch includes panels.rs. Type/instance/multiselect/docking/layout persistence need behavioral verification.

entries.task: 2D/3D viewport, tabs, selection, snapping
entries.acceptance: Plan/3D selection, modify and undo
entries.initial_assessment: PROTOTYPE / UNVERIFIED: GUI branch includes model_view.rs and model_edit.rs. Picking, snapping, cross-view selection and undo need real interaction tests.

entries.task: Revit-style shortcuts and mouse defaults
entries.acceptance: Shortcut import, conflicts, cancel, cycle and overrides
entries.initial_assessment: PARTIAL: main has keymap presets and tests; full UI integration, Tab/Escape/Space/override behavior still needs verification. #15 must be reconciled with current code.

entries.task: Shared-folder sync without a server: segment file per writer, heartbeats, snapshot writer
entries.acceptance: Two writers on a server share and on a cloud-synced folder; conflict and recovery test
entries.initial_assessment: PARTIAL PRIMITIVES / UNVERIFIED: oplog exists; shared-folder segment protocol, two-writer sync and cloud-folder recovery acceptance have not been demonstrated.

entries.task: Element borrowing (required in central mode), locks with change requests, sync UI
entries.acceptance: Real sync and ownership state; no false synced indicators
entries.initial_assessment: PLANNED / UNVERIFIED: borrowing, ownership locks, change requests and truthful sync UI require end-to-end evidence.

entries.task: Discipline models linked into the central file; clash detection there and in standalone
entries.acceptance: Linked models read only; clash report from both modes
entries.initial_assessment: PLANNED / UNVERIFIED: linked read-only discipline models and central/standalone clash-report acceptance are not demonstrated.

entries.task: Parametric family graphical editor (in the first interface)
entries.acceptance: Flex, nested type, host, preview and undo
entries.initial_assessment: PARTIAL: main has family/sketch engines; a graphical editor with host/flex/nesting/undo is not established by engine tests.

entries.task: Full architectural authoring workflows
entries.acceptance: Walls, openings, stairs/roofs etc by staged tests
entries.initial_assessment: PARTIAL: main has walls, placement, rooms and arch primitives; complete architectural authoring workflows remain staged targets.

entries.task: Structural framing and foundations
entries.acceptance: Structural classifications, constraints, sections
entries.initial_assessment: PLANNED / UNVERIFIED: structural framing/foundations workflow is a declared backlog target; no complete UI workflow was exercised.

entries.task: Connector/system browser and route editing UI
entries.acceptance: Connectivity reflected in model and UI
entries.initial_assessment: PARTIAL: route, fitting/connectivity primitives and branch desktop edits exist; complete system browser and route editing acceptance remains unverified.

entries.task: Hydraulic/airflow/electrical calculation modules
entries.acceptance: Verified reference calculations with units
entries.initial_assessment: PLANNED / UNVERIFIED: hydraulic, airflow and electrical calculation modules require units-aware reference validations; no engineering calculation compliance is claimed.

entries.task: Annotations, sheets, schedules, print/export
entries.acceptance: Repeatable view/sheet output
entries.initial_assessment: BRANCH WORK EXISTS: origin/m1c-sheets-printing workspace includes crates/sheets. Annotation/sheets/schedules/printing completeness must be reviewed there; do not duplicate it based on main alone.

entries.task: Typed command and query API: quantities with units, stable parameter IDs (EN/FR labels)
entries.acceptance: Ribbon uses it; unit-mismatch and label-lookup tests
entries.initial_assessment: PARTIAL / BRANCH: GUI branch includes crates/automation with protocol/model code. Unified stable typed command API remains a documented target; do not infer completion from filenames.

entries.task: Per-element commit rules: element revisions, last writer wins with flag, locks give change requests, all-or-nothing marks
entries.acceptance: Bulk edit of 500 elements with 1 clash applies 499 and reports 1
entries.initial_assessment: OPEN DESIGN GAP: #33/#34 track bulk-edit and per-element conflict semantics. Candidate implementation must prove the 499-success/1-conflict case.

entries.task: MCP server in the app (stdio and local HTTP with token), read-only then accepted proposals
entries.acceptance: Firestop CSV via an MCP client: preview, accept, undo; changes logged under the client
entries.initial_assessment: PROTOTYPE / BRANCH: GUI branch includes openbim-mcp-server.rs and stdio/protocol tests. Permission scope, accepted proposals and undo still require current behavior checks.

entries.task: Headless graph engine `openbim-graph`: Dynamo lacing, parallel, cache, versioned graph file
entries.acceptance: Same graph run twice gives identical change sets; lacing tests
entries.initial_assessment: PARTIAL / UNVERIFIED: automation engine code exists on GUI branch, but deterministic graph runs, Dynamo lacing and parallel cache acceptance require separate evidence (#38).

entries.task: OpenBIM Graph app (egui, Dynamo-like): library, canvas, Run bar, Watch, 3D preview, Player
entries.acceptance: Firestop graph end to end; Player runs it from the app
entries.initial_assessment: PROTOTYPE / BRANCH: GUI branch includes automation_canvas.rs/groups.rs/slider.rs. Separate-app architecture, Player and firestop end-to-end workflow are not proven.

entries.task: Python Script node in OpenBIM Graph: worker processes, declared permissions, code warning
entries.acceptance: Denied permission refused by the app; shared graph with code warns
entries.initial_assessment: PROTOTYPE / BRANCH: worker.py, worker.rs and Python tests exist. Permission denial and shared-graph warning acceptance have not been independently exercised.

entries.task: Discipline node libraries calling the calculation modules
entries.acceptance: No calculation reimplemented in nodes; standard and edition recorded
entries.initial_assessment: PLANNED / UNVERIFIED: discipline libraries must call validated calculation modules and preserve standard/edition metadata (#41).

entries.task: Incremental edit benchmark, issue #14
entries.acceptance: Demonstrate local rather than global rebuild
entries.initial_assessment: OPEN PERFORMANCE GATE: existing benchmark examples are available, but no measured incremental-edit latency/scaling report has been produced in this review.

entries.task: Spatial index for auto-router, issue #21
entries.acceptance: Query performance scaling benchmark
entries.initial_assessment: OPEN PERFORMANCE GATE: issue #21 reports router scaling. Inspect branch spatial index work and measure identical workloads before recommending replacements.
